name: genesis-tools
description: Plugins for GenesisTools CLI development and management

plugins.name: genesis-tools
plugins.description: Skills and utilities for working with GenesisTools CLI toolkit. Provides guidance for discovering, executing, and troubleshooting genesis tools with integrated workflow support.

plugins.name: genesis-tools-mods
plugins.description: Claude Code mods for GenesisTools, each switched by mods.<feature> in the hooks file: the whole diff of a cut diff-hook message under the call's row, the subagent's model on its rows and beside its type in the agents panel (mods.agentRow, through Claude Code's subagentStatusLine), idle compaction before the prompt cache expires, /decisions, links in the streamed reply, a git and PR band with /mod-git, [ask] on tool rows, live spinner progress, a prompt cache countdown across sessions, /tmp usage, a live agents band, and a ledger of what hooks inject with repeat dedupe; the git, agents and hooks parts open sidebars (/mod-git, /mod-agents, /mod-hooks). Every mod but the full diff and idle compaction starts off: tools agents hooks mods enable <name|all> --write. Install with: tools agents hooks mods install --write.

plugins.name: genesis-tools-server
plugins.description: A single Claude Code command for Linux server security auditing: log analysis, intrusion detection, malware scanning, and rootkit detection. Not an MCP server, despite the name.

plugins.name: spotify
plugins.description: Deep analytics over a personal Spotify listening history and taste compatibility between two people, via `tools spotify`.
